rules_eras.label: 2012-2016 Basic Agreement
rules_eras.summary: Agreement reached in late November 2011 (announced Nov 22, 2011 per secondary source) introduced draft signing bonus pools for the first 10 rounds with tax/pick-forfeiture penalties, minor-league-only draft contracts, and Competitive Balance lottery rounds; 40-round draft. Governed the 2015 and 2016 drafts.

rules_eras.label: 2017-2021 Basic Agreement
rules_eras.summary: Tentative deal Dec 1, 2016, ratified mid-December 2016, expiring Dec 1, 2021. Kept the 40-round draft (2017-2019) and revised qualifying-offer compensation; the 2020 (5 rounds) and 2021 (20 rounds, moved to July/All-Star week) drafts were shortened under the March 26, 2020 pandemic agreement.

rules_eras.label: March 26, 2020 MLB-MLBPA pandemic agreement (draft provisions)
rules_eras.summary: Let MLB cut the 2020 draft to as few as five rounds (it chose five, held remotely June 10-11) and the 2021 draft to 20 rounds; undrafted 2020 signings capped at $20,000.

rules_eras.label: 2022-2026 Basic Agreement
rules_eras.summary: Signed March 10, 2022 after the 99-day lockout. Made 20 rounds permanent, added a pre-draft combine, 75% slot guarantee for top-300 prospects who take physicals, draft-and-follow, a six-pick draft lottery from 2023 (with eligibility limits), and Prospect Promotion Incentive picks. Governed the 2022-2026 drafts.
